subfiles.title: List of Papers: Railways—Kwantung, items 2–35
subfiles.about: Four-page register indexing diplomatic papers concerning the South Manchuria Railway Company, railway affairs in the Kwantung Leased Territory, and related Sino-Japanese transportation questions during the 1930s.
subfiles.summary: Register: South Manchuria Railway purchasing, finances, reorganization, Chinese rail competition, League representations, and a 1939 dispute over undelivered locomotive parts.

interest: Shows the South Manchuria Railway as commercial enterprise, administration, and strategic tool under the Kwantung Army.
